items.exampleEn: Our school is on a hill.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校在一座山丘上。

items.exampleEn: There are no clouds in the sky.
Let's go to the beach this weekend.
items.exampleZh: 這個週末我們去海灘吧。

items.exampleEn: The moon is very bright tonight.
Pollution is a big problem in the city.
items.exampleZh: 汙染是城市裡的大問題。

items.sentenceEn: That cloud looks like a rabbit.
items.sentenceZh: 那朵雲看起來像一隻兔子。

items.audioEn: We can't see the moon tonight. There are too many clouds.
items.audioZh: 我們今晚看不到月亮，雲太多了。
items.questionZh: 為什麼今晚看不到月亮？

items.sentenceEn: Please don't walk on the grass.
There is a lot of pollution in big cities.

items.stemEn: The cows are eating ____ in the field.
We swim in the sea and play at the ____.
items.stemZh: 我們在海裡游泳，在海灘上玩。

items.passageEn: My family lives in a big city. There is a lot of pollution, so the sky is often gray. Every summer, we visit my uncle's farm. There, the grass is green, and the cows walk on the hills. At night, we can see the moon and many stars.
items.passageZh: 我們家住在大城市。這裡汙染很嚴重，所以天空常常是灰色的。每年夏天，我們都去叔叔的農場。那裡的草很綠，牛在山丘上走來走去。晚上，我們可以看到月亮和很多星星。

questions.questionZh: 城市的天空為什麼常常是灰色的？

referenceEn: The moon is very beautiful tonight.
rubricZh: 「月亮」用 the moon（前面加 the）
「好漂亮」可用 very beautiful、so beautiful、very pretty 等

items.instructionZh: 用 beach 造一個句子，說說你在海灘做什麼，或想去哪個海灘。
referenceEn: I like to walk on the beach.
I play volleyball at the beach with my friends.
rubricZh: 「在海灘」可用 on the beach 或 at the beach
